accepted_rule: all 24 x-neighbors rational and uniquely reconstructed, defined j, Phi_23 incidence, sum neighbors=-P
competing_prediction: neighbor lifts fail or new columns absorb all rank gain
primary_prediction: one of the two modular j adjacencies to the 14 ambiguous old orbits produces a verified row and reduces residual dimension
rank_rule: append every accepted row and all new orbit columns; compare anchored GF4021 rank, discarded-new-column projection, and old-column kernel with and without 1975 sign rows
source_rule: exactly the six source points whose Phi_23(j,Y) fully splits in the sealed screen, in saved order
